title: properties filter: minimum forced-present fields beyond messageId undefined
description: §4.1 says messageId is always included regardless of the properties filter, but says nothing about chatId, chatKind, senderId, or other fields that are practically necessary to render any notification. Without a defined minimum set, a server could return a payload with only messageId, which is useless to a client. The spec needs to define the immutable minimum field set.
close_reason: Adopted emailpush model: properties list is authoritative, no forced floor. Replaced 'messageId always included regardless' with a MUST-support minimum set matching the default set.
